ast.name: setText
ast.source: Ink is all about enabling pen use directly in your Markdown notes.
ast.target: Ink 讓你可以直接在 Markdown 筆記中使用數位筆。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: In any Markdown note, run the following command to begin writing where your Cursor is.
ast.target: 在任何 Markdown 筆記中執行以下命令，即可從游標所在位置開始手寫。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: These can be added too and can be resized right in your Markdown file. Use the purple lock icon to save framing, or the standard lock icon to save the drawing but revert the framing.
ast.target: 也可以加入繪圖區塊，並直接在 Markdown 檔案中調整大小。使用紫色鎖頭圖示可儲存取景範圍；一般鎖頭圖示則會儲存繪圖，但還原取景範圍。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: The 'scribble' feature of the apple pencil can interfere with the ability to write in ink embeds.
ast.target: Apple Pencil 的「隨手寫」功能可能會干擾 Ink 嵌入區塊中的書寫。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: To use ink you will need to turn off scribble in your device settings.
ast.target: 若要使用 Ink，請在裝置設定中關閉「隨手寫」。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: If using Obsidian Sync, turn on "sync all other types" in the Obsidian Sync settings.
ast.target: 如果使用 Obsidian Sync，請在 Obsidian Sync 設定中啟用「同步所有其他類型」。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Fixed iPad Scribble functionality interfering with Ink.
ast.target: 修正 iPad「隨手寫」功能干擾 Ink 的問題。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Experimental fix to Wacom pen erasers.
ast.target: 針對 Wacom 數位筆橡皮擦加入實驗性修正。

ast.name: setText
ast.target: 修正嵌入區塊周圍的間距問題。

ast.name: setText
ast.target: 重新設計工具列，讓操作更清楚。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Refined stroke sizes to match across writing, drawing, and different input types.
ast.target: 調整筆畫粗細，使手寫、繪圖及不同輸入方式的粗細一致。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Fixed Ink previews not appearing on linux.
ast.target: 修正 Linux 上無法顯示 Ink 預覽的問題。

ast.name: setText
ast.target: 修正捲動位置隨機跳動的問題。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Tips for using Ink, compatibility with other processes, and migrating from older versions.
ast.target: Ink 使用技巧、與其他流程的相容性，以及舊版本遷移說明。

ast.name: setText
ast.target: 以短片示範 Ink 的功能。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: For a more intuitive experience, turn on "Slash commands" in "Obsidian settings" / "core plugins" or install and set up the community plugin "Slash Commander".
ast.target: 若想要更直覺的體驗，請在「Obsidian 設定」／「核心外掛」中啟用「斜線命令」，或安裝並設定社群外掛「Slash Commander」。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Two fingers or right mouse button to reframe. Cmd + right mouse button to zoom, or Cmd + scroll wheel.
ast.target: 使用雙指或滑鼠右鍵調整取景範圍。按住 Cmd 搭配滑鼠右鍵或滾輪即可縮放。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Right click on a locked embed to copy or delete it.
ast.target: 在已鎖定的嵌入區塊上按右鍵，即可複製或刪除。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Hold cmd/ctrl to switch to eraser temporarily.
ast.target: 按住 Cmd／Ctrl 可暫時切換為橡皮擦。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: If using an iPad, the Apple pencil "Scribble" setting can interfere with input in Ink sections. Disable it in iPadOS settings for a better experience.
ast.target: 如果使用 iPad，Apple Pencil 的「隨手寫」設定可能會干擾 Ink 區塊中的輸入。請在 iPadOS 設定中停用它，以獲得更好的體驗。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: If using "Obsidian Sync", turn on "sync all other types" in the Obsidian Sync settings.
ast.target: 如果使用「Obsidian Sync」，請在 Obsidian Sync 設定中啟用「同步所有其他類型」。

ast.name: text
ast.target: 遷移舊版 Ink 檔案

ast.name: text
ast.source: This version of Ink uses a new SVG format. Migrate legacy .writing/.drawing files and older Ink SVG files still on the previous format to unlock newer features.
ast.target: 此版本的 Ink 使用新的 SVG 格式。將舊版 .writing／.drawing 檔案，以及仍使用先前格式的 Ink SVG 檔案遷移，即可使用新功能。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Bulk-convert v2 SVG files still on <tldraw> metadata (referenced by embeds) to ink-canvas in place. Drawing embed viewBox is refit to stroke bounds.
ast.target: 將嵌入區塊參照、仍使用 <tldraw> 中繼資料的 v2 SVG 檔案批次就地轉換為 ink-canvas。繪圖嵌入區塊的 viewBox 會重新調整以符合筆畫邊界。

ast.name: setName
ast.source: Developer: Migrate tldraw SVG to ink-canvas
ast.target: 開發者工具：將 tldraw SVG 遷移至 ink-canvas

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: For information on this plugin's development, visit the links below.
ast.target: 若想了解此外掛的開發資訊，請前往下方連結。

ast.name: addLinkRow
ast.target: 以短片示範 Ink 的功能。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Shows a toolbar toggle while editing so you can draw with your finger on touch devices. When off, fingers scroll the note as usual.
ast.target: 編輯時在工具列顯示切換按鈕，讓你能在觸控裝置上用手指繪圖。關閉時，手指會照常捲動筆記。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Which side undo/redo and extend controls appear on while editing.
ast.target: 編輯時，復原／重做與延伸控制按鈕要顯示在哪一側。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Features under active testing. They may not work on all devices and might be removed or changed in the next release. Expand for details.
ast.target: 這些功能仍在測試中，可能無法在所有裝置上運作，也可能於下一版移除或變更。展開以查看詳情。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Connects to the Boox companion app for passing through smoother pen strokes on supported tablets.
ast.target: 連線至 Boox 配套應用程式，在支援的平板上傳遞更流暢的筆畫。

ast.name: setName
ast.target: 啟用 Boox 配套應用程式

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: While held, the pen barrel button (button 2) erases instead of panning. May conflict with right-click pan on some setups.
ast.target: 按住筆身按鈕（按鈕 2）時，暫時使用橡皮擦而非平移。部分設定下可能與右鍵平移衝突。

ast.name: setName
ast.target: 側邊按鈕暫時切換橡皮擦

ast.name: textContent
ast.source: Automatically detect pen or mouse from pressure (auto), use pen pressure and faithful smoothing (pen), or simulated pressure with higher smoothing (mouse).
ast.target: 依筆壓自動判斷使用觸控筆或滑鼠（自動）；觸控筆模式使用實際筆壓，平滑處理較忠於原筆跡；滑鼠模式則模擬筆壓，並加強平滑處理。

ast.name: append
ast.target: 上次偵測到的輸入方式：

ast.name: append
ast.source: If detection is incorrect, choose Pen or Mouse manually.
ast.target: 若偵測結果不正確，請手動選擇「觸控筆」或「滑鼠」。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: While editing a Markdown file, run the action 'insert new hand drawn section' to embed a drawing canvas.
ast.target: 編輯 Markdown 檔案時，執行「插入新的手繪區塊」動作即可嵌入繪圖畫布。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: While editing a Markdown file, run the action 'new handwriting section' to embed a section for writing with a pen.
ast.target: 編輯 Markdown 檔案時，執行「新增手寫區塊」動作即可嵌入可用數位筆書寫的區塊。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Height in pixels of each ruled line. Only affects new writing embeds.
ast.target: 每一行橫線的高度，以像素為單位。僅影響新建立的手寫嵌入區塊。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Number of empty lines shown below your writing while editing. Writing reaches the last line before the embed extends in height.
ast.target: 編輯時在筆跡下方顯示的空白行數。書寫到最後一行時，嵌入區塊才會增加高度。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: Always back up your files. Expand for details.
ast.target: 請務必備份檔案。展開以查看詳情。

ast.name: setName
ast.target: 此外掛處於 Beta 階段

ast.name: text
ast.source: Beta means the plugin is still evolving. Changes to embed formats and file-handling features, even when thoroughly tested, may occasionally introduce issues that affect your vault. Always keep backups of your data.
ast.target: Beta 表示此外掛仍在持續開發。嵌入格式與檔案處理功能的變更，即使經過完整測試，仍可能偶爾出現影響儲存庫的問題。請務必備份資料。

ast.name: setDesc
ast.source: When enabled, debug information is written to an ink-debug.md file in your vault root. This includes writing and drawing activity, so do not enable this unless you are actively troubleshooting a bug to provide logs for a bug report. Disable it again once you're done.
ast.target: 啟用後，除錯資訊會寫入儲存庫根目錄的 ink-debug.md 檔案，其中包含手寫與繪圖活動。請僅在排查問題、準備提供錯誤回報紀錄時啟用，完成後請再次停用。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: When you lock or save the embed, those strokes become visible again.
ast.target: 鎖定或儲存嵌入區塊後，這些筆畫會再次顯示。

ast.source: Ink is all about enabling stylus use directly in your markdown notes.
ast.target: Ink 讓你可以直接在 Markdown 筆記中使用觸控筆。

ast.name: setText
ast.source: Here's a quick rundown to help you get started...
ast.target: 以下是幫助你開始使用的快速介紹...

ast.name: setText
ast.source: In any markdown note, run the following command to begin writing where your cursor is.
ast.target: 在任何 Markdown 筆記中執行以下命令，即可從游標所在位置開始手寫。

ast.name: setText

ast.name: setText
